rationale: The plan correctly identifies the 3' tag-seq chemistry, forbids TPM/FPKM/length offsets, runs DESeq2 Wald with ~condition and control as reference, uses median-of-ratios and TMM inside the models, applies BH and apeglm shrinkage, and includes full QC with an explicit no-removal outlier policy and a stated n=3 power caveat. The low-count filter uses the generic ~10-in-3 floor rather than the lower floor appropriate for a tag library, though the rule and retained count are reported. The |LFC|>1 threshold is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold in the test. Enrichment was not asked for; the added fgsea step is defensible (full ranked list, metric stated, size window, universe coverage reported) but names no gene-set version, and software versions are not explicitly required in the report.
